# Branch performance

Fair ranking with empirical-Bayes shrinkage so small branches are not over-ranked
on noise. Never rank on raw ratios without showing uncertainty.

## Shrunk ranking (active / total accounts)

```{r}
#| echo: false
rank <- read_table("branch_shrink_rank")
if (!is.null(rank)) print(utils::head(rank, 30)) else cat("No shrink-rank table in this run.\n")
```

## Methods

`shrink_rank()` applies a beta-binomial prior (uniform default). Raw rate is shown
alongside the shrunk rate. Funnel plots and robust z-scores are available in
`R/mart_branch_performance.R` for outlier detection.
